Getting there exposed four defects, three of them in the proving tools rather than the product; all three are fixed and each fix is proven in both directions.

theProvingToolsWereTheDefect.oneLine: Four defects, three of them in the instruments, and every one produced a plausible reading of a real artifact rather than an error.
theProvingToolsWereTheDefect.exporterHadNoKeyHandling: Every tenant-private read returned the gate's refusal and was reported as 'no rendered rows' - a credential problem wearing a data problem's clothes.
theProvingToolsWereTheDefect.settleConditionWasSatisfiedByTheWrongTab: It waited on the SUM of every queue's children, and every Development services tab renders all five queues, so a populated Pipeline queue satisfied it on the first snapshot FOR EVERY TAB. Six tabs reported settled that were never waited on; the Licences queue was recorded as 0 rows; the check then refused a verdict on an empty roll. The live app serves 73 business licences for bastrop_tx.
theProvingToolsWereTheDefect.finalCaptureWasTakenOnTheWrongTab: The single-file design rested on 'the lens renders all five region queues into the document at load'. Measured: a Development services tab does, the two non-domain tabs leave them EMPTY, and the sweep ended on flood-study - so the artifact written was 33KB of empty queues.
theProvingToolsWereTheDefect.peopleRuleNamedASitusSentinelAsAPerson: 'table cells name people [TX USA]' on the live surface. Live permits carry a situs that is nothing but the state and country suffix; the all-caps alternation that catches 'DEBORAH MOORE' matches any two all-caps tokens. NOT A PII LEAK - a false positive. Fixed by naming the sentinel vocabulary, not by relaxing the name shapes.
theProvingToolsWereTheDefect.orderRuleDemandedGlobalMonotonicity: It required globally non-decreasing expiry offsets while the design's own exported comparator sorts by status severity FIRST. It FAILED a correct live surface. Now band-aware and strictly stronger: bands must appear in the product's severity order AND offsets must be non-decreasing within a band. Band ranks come from LICENSE_STATUS_VALUES, where every unrecognised status collapses to ONE SHARED LAST RANK.
theProvingToolsWereTheDefect.lesson: None of these produced an error. The only thing that caught them was pointing the tools at live data and reading the numbers instead of the exit code - which is exactly what OPS-17 A-146 says a demo pack cannot do.

theCredential.keyDriftWasCardedNotFixed: Carded to OPS-16 as P-362 in _inbox/2026-09-18_g154_to_ops16_admin_bootstrap_key_card.md. The card's substance is that nothing can tell whether the local value is a stale copy of a rotated production value or a deliberate local development value, and those two readings want opposite fixes - so it is a decision with an owner, not a chore. Measured for the card: rg -c BOOTSTRAP returns ZERO across the P-305 inventory (.md and .json), the rotation runbook, and OPS-16 itself; the runbook's Step 1 pair table carries the engine key and the service key and has no admin-bootstrap row; exactly one local copy exists across ten known repo roots, of which five do not exist locally.

scratch.entry: d12-main-uat serves bastrop_tx Development services live: inspections 2041, code-violations 1509, work-orders 187, business-licenses 73, pipeline 294. All 200 with a jurisdiction_tenant=bastrop_tx key; 401 anonymously.

hauska-mcp-server/.env's HAUSKA_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_KEY has DRIFTED from production's. Production's live value is in Secret Manager as HAUSKA_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_KEY in hauska-prod-497015. A lane that needs to mint will hit this.
A settle condition that sums across ALL regions is satisfied by whichever region loads first. Wait on the region you just opened.
'Unchanged across two consecutive polls' is satisfied by two zeros. For a surface that must be populated, wait for populated THEN stable.
Do not pass a credential in a query string when the tool writes its own URLs into an artifact. A manifest that records every visited URL will copy the key into the proof.
A monotonicity rule over rendered values is invalid when the product's own comparator is band-major. Read the product's comparator before writing a rule about its order.
An all-caps-pair name heuristic matches a bare US situs sentinel ('TX USA'), which live Bastrop permits carry. P-214/X9's bare-situs class arrives in any surface that draws addresses.
Driving the app with ?hauskaKey= to authenticate the export: works, but leaks the key into the manifest's URL list. Use a context init script seeding localStorage instead.
PowerShell 5.1's Invoke-WebRequest against d12-main-uat dies with 'The underlying connection was closed' on TLS. Node's fetch needs --use-system-ca here. Both are environment facts, not product bugs.

G-135 (which key a lane may hold) remains OPEN and still needs the operator's disposition. This lane minted a key under A-118's precedent rather than waiting on it; the planner may wish to close G-135 on this resolution.

The load strip (workload rankings) is hidden on every surface measured, so the naming rule over it is unexercised everywhere. A surface that DRAWS a ranking would be the first real test of acceptance item 2.
